title: Strength-ductility synergy of Al-bearing low-density refractory TiNbMo0.5AlX medium entropy alloys via precipitation
process_description: prepared by arc melting under an argon atmosphere using raw elements with purities ≥ 99.9 wt.%, remelted at least six times to ensure chemical homogeneity, melted for 2 min at a constant current of 450A
